The '''SuperHaul Model IIA mod 3''' was a modified cargo [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] produced by [[Ubrikkian Transports/Legends|Ubrikkian Transports]]. Armed with two [[power harpoon launcher]]s, [[SuperHaul]]s were deployed as harvesting skiffs on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]] targeting the native [[jer'usk]]ae due to their hard skin being rich in [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbarides]].
